subject: Operator affidavit & retention snapshot for EU-only inference
messages:
From: Marta Kozlowski <marta.kozlowski@meditech.eu>
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Cc: Tom Sandoval <tom.sandoval@legalops.acmehealth.com>
Date: Mon, 27 Mar 2028 09:12:00 +01:00
Subject: Request: operator affidavit + retention snapshot for EU-only deployment

Hi Lauren,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Meditech is proceeding with the in-region pilot but our legal team needs two concrete items before we can sign:

1) An operator affidavit (short signed statement) that specifies who has operator-level access to the EU-only inference cluster, the countries where operator seats are located, and the contractual controls (SCCs + any supplemental clause references).
2) A retention snapshot: a CSV listing retention policy points for data types we send to inference (logs, model inputs, KV cache durations, backups) and the current configured retention in seconds/days.

Can Redwood provide a draft affidavit we can review and a canonical retention snapshot extracted from the environment? Timelines: legal wants to close this week if possible.

Appreciate a quick confirmation of what you can provide and an ETA.

Best,
Marta
Marta Kozlowski
Head of Security & Privacy
Meditech GmbH

--
Attachment: (none)

From: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Marta Kozlowski <marta.kozlowski@meditech.eu>
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, naomi_feldman@redwood.ai, Tom Sandoval <tom.sandoval@legalops.acmehealth.com>
Date: Mon, 27 Mar 2028 10:03:00 +01:00
Subject: Re: Request: operator affidavit + retention snapshot for EU-only deployment

Hi Marta — thanks for the clear ask. We can absolutely provide both items. Quick answers and next steps: 

- Operator affidavit: Rishi will draft a short affidavit that lists operator roles, locations, and the contractual references (SCCs + our EU Addendum). We’ll include clear language about no cross-border operator access for the EU-only cluster and our on-call escalation routing.
- Retention snapshot: Naomi will pull the canonical retention export from the EU-only cluster and provide a CSV with rows for: request body retention, KV cache TTL, model input logs, debugging traces, backups, and snapshots.

ETA: initial draft affidavit + retention CSV by EOD today (Mon 27th). If you need a redline-friendly Word/Doc, say the word — we can also send a DocuSign for signature after agreement.

One clarifying Q: do you need operator seat country-level IPs (i.e., static IP ranges) or just the country list and corporate entity locations? IP ranges can take longer to coordinate.

Best,
Lauren Bishop
Director, Product Compliance
Redwood Inference

--
Attachment: (none)

From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Marta Kozlowski <marta.kozlowski@meditech.eu>, lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Cc: naomi_feldman@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 27 Mar 2028 15:28:00 +01:00
Subject: Draft: Operator affidavit (for review)

Hi Marta / Lauren,

Attached is a short draft affidavit that follows the template we use for EU-only customers. Key points included:
- Operator roles with potential access: Platform Ops, On-call GPU Ops, SRE Incident Response
- Location of operator teams: corporate entities in "Germany (Redwood EU Ops GmbH)" and "Poland (Redwood Support Sp. z o.o.)"; no operator seats located in the US for EU-only customers
- Access controls: KMS-backed keying (customer-managed where requested), MFA + privileged-session logging, just-in-time elevation with approval workflow
- SCCs: we reference the EU Commission Standard Contractual Clauses (Controller-Processor) and our EU Addendum (link in related_links)

Also attaching: retention_snapshot_20280325.csv (export from the EU-only inference project) — brief notes inside the CSV for each row.

Attachments: operator_affidavit_draft.pdf (1 page), retention_snapshot_20280325.csv

Requesting: Marta, could you confirm whether the country-level operator list above is acceptable or whether you need IP ranges and the names of individual engineers (we normally avoid naming individuals in affidavits)?

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Infrastructure Security (serving runtime)
Redwood Inference

--
Attachments: operator_affidavit_draft.pdf (application/pdf), retention_snapshot_20280325.csv (text/csv)

From: Marta Kozlowski <marta.kozlowski@meditech.eu>
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Cc: Tom Sandoval <tom.sandoval@legalops.acmehealth.com>
Date: Tue, 28 Mar 2028 08:47:00 +01:00
Subject: Re: Draft: Operator affidavit (for review)

Lauren / Rishi — thank you, this is exactly what we needed. A few small asks from legal: 

- Replace the phrase "no operator seats located in the US for EU-only customers" with the slightly stronger "no operator access from outside the EEA without Meditech prior written consent".
- Add an explicit line that backups stored offsite (if any) are encrypted at rest and subject to the same retention as primary logs.
- The retention snapshot looks good; legal would like a separate line in the CSV for "short-term diagnostic traces" with the configured purge interval.

If you can incorporate those three edits and send back a signable PDF, we can route it to our legal ops and sign by EOD Tuesday. Tom will confirm the procurement/payment gating.

Also, we prefer a DocuSign flow for signing.

Best,
Marta

--
Attachment: (none)

From: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Marta Kozlowski <marta.kozlowski@meditech.eu>
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, naomi_feldman@redwood.ai, Tom Sandoval <tom.sandoval@legalops.acmehealth.com>, procurement@novusmed.com
Date: Tue, 28 Mar 2028 11:05:00 +01:00
Subject: Re: Draft: Operator affidavit (for review)

Marta — thanks for the edits. We incorporated the three items you requested, updated the CSV with a short-term diagnostic traces row, and generated a signable PDF. Next steps:

1) Attached: signed_affidavit-docusign.pdf (we’ve prepared the DocuSign envelope and shared the verification link).
2) Naomi uploaded the retention snapshot CSV to the secure drive (link in related_links).

Summary of the final commitments (for your legal ops):
- No operator access from outside the EEA without Meditech prior written consent.
- Backups encrypted at rest and subject to the same retention schedule as primary logs (retention column in the CSV).
- Short-term diagnostic traces included and set to auto-purge after 7 days (configurable).

Please confirm receipt and we’ll trigger the DocuSign send to the signatories you specify. Happy to hop on a 15-min call if Tom wants to walk through the wording.

Best regards,
Lauren Bishop
Director, Product Compliance
Redwood Inference

--
Attachments: signed_affidavit-docusign.pdf (application/pdf)
